summary: Humanitarian cash transfers are crucial for vulnerable populations in crisis situations. HOPE supports organizations in disbursing cash transfers to beneficiaries, ensuring accountability, and traceability. The system is used in over 20 countries by UNICEF and its partners to manage complex processes and provide unified reporting. HOPE enhances programme quality, prevents implementation bottlenecks, and promotes data protection standards. It facilitates real-time communication with beneficiaries and verifies payment receipt. The platform aims to simplify cash transfer delivery at scale in humanitarian contexts.
